top_5_findings.category: Hermes Agent product update - TUI v2
top_5_findings.author: @Teknium
top_5_findings.summary: Teknium announced TUI v2 is coming for Hermes Agent. Major terminal UI upgrade from the project lead with high engagement. Signals significant UX improvements for the agent interface.

top_5_findings.category: Hermes Agent product integration - GPT Image 2.0
top_5_findings.author: @NousResearch
top_5_findings.summary: Nous Research announced GPT Image 2.0 is now available natively in Hermes Agent. Users can run `hermes update` and select image generation tool model. Extremely high engagement indicates major community interest in multimodal capabilities.

top_5_findings.category: Hermes Agent model update - Step 3.5 Flash
top_5_findings.author: @NousResearch
top_5_findings.summary: Step 3.5 Flash is now live for Nous Portal users, free for the next 10 days. Hermes Agent users can run 'hermes update' and 'hermes model' to configure access. Partnership with StepFun_ai.

top_5_findings.category: Hermes Agent ecosystem - native macOS GUI (Scarf)
top_5_findings.author: @QingQ77 / @awizemann (RT by @Teknium)
top_5_findings.summary: Scarf - a native macOS GUI for Hermes AI agent built in Swift. Supports managing multiple local and remote Hermes servers simultaneously with real-time visualization of agent activity, sessions, configuration and system status. GitHub: https://github.com/awizemann/scarf

top_5_findings.author: @Teknium
top_5_findings.summary: Hermes Agent is being used to manage a utility substation - a significant industrial/IoT application of the agent framework. Notable use case expansion beyond software development into critical infrastructure management.
